shared_elements: low relief carving on a tall rectangular stone surface
repetition of a single motif type in a row/register
frond- or leaf-like plant motif (palm-like fan in A, palmettes in B)
a linear framing band along an edge
justification: Both are tall rectangular stone panels worked in shallow relief and both include a repeated motif set out in an ordered sequence with frond-like fans and small discs, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A stacks crude, boldly outlined animal figures into horizontal registers beneath a zigzag band on a rough, weathered pillar, while B confines a delicate, symmetrical vegetal chain to a vertical strip along one edge of an otherwise blank, smoothly finished slab.
